result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers name flat hierarchy as the root cause and tie it closely to the 28/26/24px bold lines and the four button styles. A's fix order puts the type scale and buttons first, matching the core problem, and it has a clear section on what already works (section order, warm palette, 16px body text, red text that is likely still readable). B ranks the vendor photos first, puts the primary-button fix fourth, and says almost nothing is already fine; its claim that red on pink is hard to read is also questionable. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B names the root cause outright: there's no hierarchy because size, weight, color and treatment are all nearly the same. It also points out that 'Get tickets', the main action, is the weakest-looking button, and it ranks the type scale and buttons as the first fixes. A gives a similar diagnosis, but it puts the vendor photos first, wrongly says #8b0000 on pale pink has poor contrast, and says little about what already works, while B lists several things worth keeping.
